# unlink

Remove one file name through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/unlink unwanted.txt
```

Remove exactly one file or symbolic link. Removing a link does not remove its target.

## Notes

Workspace builds use the MoonBit 2026-11-26 toolchain.

- Directories and extra operands are rejected.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
